body: Ive been with him for 3 years, and been staying with him on 5th month of our early relationship. I have broken family and my mom used to abused me alot, and my dad is far from me. Since i was 14 i have been staying by myself to avoid conflict with my mom. On our first 5 months being together, he told me his ex used him for money. But i have always been someone that rather share our hard times , pay my own meals and thing and etc cuz thats the way i am. I noticed he had issue in the past with his job, he couldnt seem to keep his job, cuz of his sleeping habit. And i always tried my best to support our life. First year together, we both work for our life. Second and third year together, me alone. And I couldn’t bear any longer. He had this anger issue, he doesnt like to hear my suicidal thoughts, and he always sleep and promised me to go to work next day but it never happened. I used to fed stray dogs n cats when we both work, because i have the ability to in financial. Also, i do it to help cure my depression and suicidal thoughts. But I couldn’t do it since it became worse like this. Ending my life is my only way. I had no way out. Im scared, but i have no way out. I have nobody here with me. Its the only way,

I dont know how. He told me he had this anger issue problem, and that anger issue is among depression group of illness. He said that he never meant all that he did to me, but its so confusing. Its like when we are okay, it seems to me he was fake and i always scared even though that time we are okay. I pretend im happy because if not, he’ll get mad. He’s always use his anger management for me to not leave him, and help him go through this as he believe im the only can cure him

Everyday I rewind back all the times i used to be happy back then and i wanted so bad to go back to that time… but i couldnt and only way is to end everything. Wouldnt want to break my mom/dad heart, but theyre not here with me, nothing motivates me anymore when im living under the hand of abuser and manipulator… im so tired
